# CodingEasyPeasy

> > A comprehensive platform for beginners to learn web development through interactive HTML, CSS, and JavaScript tutorials and hands-on projects.

CodingEasyPeasy provides step-by-step guides and practical projects for students and programming enthusiasts learning front-end web development. The platform emphasizes interactive learning through building real-world components and tools using HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript.

## Key Topics

- HTML5
- CSS
- JavaScript
- Web Development
- Interactive Components
- Front-End Development
- HTML/CSS Tutorials
- Beginner Projects
- DOM Manipulation
- Responsive Design
- Form Validation
- CSS Animations
- Local Storage
- API Integration
- Semantic HTML

## Core Pages

- [CodingEasyPeasy](https://codingeasypeasy.com): Homepage featuring programming and mathematics tutorials with HTML, CSS, and web development.
- [About](https://codingeasypeasy.com/about): Platform overview for students and enthusiasts learning Python, JavaScript, PHP, and Java.

## Interactive Web Components

- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive Color Picker](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-color-picker): JavaScript tutorial for building an interactive RGB color picker tool for web development.
- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive Password Strength Checker](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-password-strength-checker): Real-time form validation tutorial for building a password strength checker tool.
- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive File Upload Component](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-file-upload-component): Guide to creating custom file upload components supporting PDF and DOC formats.
- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive QR Code Generator](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-qr-code-generator): API integration tutorial for building a QR code generator with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive Blog Comment Section](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-blog-comment-section): Form validation tutorial for creating interactive comment sections with HTML and CSS.

## Data & Productivity Tools

- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive To-Do List With Local Storage](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-to-do-list-with-local-storage): DOM manipulation tutorial for building a to-do app with local storage persistence.
- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive Expense Tracker](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-expense-tracker): Interactive finance app tutorial for creating a personal expense tracking tool.
- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive Markdown Editor](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-markdown-editor): Frontend project guide for creating a Markdown text editor with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive Simple Text Editor](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-simple-text-editor): Step-by-step guide for creating a text formatting tool with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## E-Commerce & Business Projects

- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive Product Catalog](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-product-catalog): Tutorial for building responsive e-commerce product catalogs with HTML5 and CSS.
- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive Digital Business Card](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-digital-business-card): Responsive design guide for creating interactive digital business cards with HTML and CSS.

## Advanced Web Design & Effects

- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive Parallax Scrolling Website](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-parallax-scrolling-website): CSS animations guide for creating parallax scrolling effects in HTML5 web pages.
- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive Webpage With A Sticky Header](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-webpage-with-a-sticky-header): Navigation design tutorial for implementing sticky headers with HTML and CSS.
- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive Storytelling Website](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-storytelling-website): Interactive storytelling tutorial for creating choose-your-own-adventure web projects.

## Utility & Learning Tools

- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive Multiplication Table](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-multiplication-table): Interactive HTML5 and JavaScript tutorial for building a multiplication table tool.
- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive Typing Speed Test](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-typing-speed-test): Tutorial for creating an interactive typing speed test with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- [Build A Simple HTML & CSS Interactive Temperature Converter](https://codingeasypeasy.com/blog/build-a-simple-html-css-interactive-temperature-converter): JavaScript tutorial for building a Celsius-Fahrenheit-Kelvin temperature converter.
